name: Rejection Sampling for Arbitrary Media
aliases: Unbiased distance sampling for arbitrary media
definition: An unbiased Monte Carlo method to sample the distance to the next interaction point in heterogeneous participating media, avoiding the bias of classic ray marching.
summary: Rejection Sampling for Arbitrary Media is an unbiased Monte Carlo technique that samples interaction distances in heterogeneous media using rejection steps, avoiding the bias of classic ray marching.
